title: The Rebirth of a Masterpiece: The Journey of A 1967 Iso Grifo Restoration
excerpt: In the world of classic Italian cars, few names evoke as much nostalgia and admiration as the Iso Grifo GL350.
recognition: Placed in Class, Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance 2004

blocks.html: In the world of classic Italian cars, few names evoke as much nostalgia and admiration as the Iso Grifo GL350. This luxury sports car, produced in limited numbers during the ’60s and ’70s, has captured the hearts of vintage car enthusiasts worldwide. With its sleek design and powerful performance, the Iso Grifo represents a fusion of engineering prowess and artistic finesse.

When StreetWorks was still a one-man shop, our ventures into Italian car restoration began with a 1967 Iso Grifo GL350—a car that embodies both the elegance and excitement of its era. For Italian car lovers and exotic car owners, the allure of an Iso Rivolta lies not just in its aesthetic appeal but also in the rich history it carries. Here we’ll take you through the fascinating tale of one particular Iso Grifo’s transformation and how it became a symbol of StreetWork’s success in classic car restoration.
A Leap of Faith in 1999

In 1999, StreetWorks was still in its infancy when an architect from Elkhart Lake approached us with a leap of faith. Despite being a brand new venture, we were entrusted with restoring his cherished Iso Grifo GL350. The architect was referred to us by a satisfied customer who had experienced our meticulous craftsmanship firsthand. It was a pivotal moment for us—a chance to prove our expertise and passion for breathing new life into vintage automobiles.

For the architect, entrusting a newly established shop with his beloved car was no small decision. It required confidence in our skills and dedication to preserving the car’s authenticity. The Iso Grifo was more than just a vehicle; it was a connection to the past, a testament to the golden age of Italian automotive design.
The Expertise Behind the Restoration

Back in 1999, our shop was a one-man operation that specialized in muscle cars. To tackle the complexity of the Iso Grifo restoration, we hired an expert mechanic specifically for this project. This decision proved to be instrumental in achieving the level of excellence that the car deserved. The mechanic’s knowledge and dedication played a crucial role in transforming the Iso Grifo into a masterpiece.

During the initial restoration, we recognized the importance of expertise. To ensure the Iso Grifo received the care it deserved, we consulted an Iso Grifo expert who provided invaluable insights into the car’s unique characteristics. This collaboration helped us maintain the authenticity of the restoration process while infusing it with our creative touch.
Redefining Excellence in Restoration

The restoration began with a comprehensive overhaul of the Iso Grifo’s body, mechanics, and interior. StreetWorks understands that every detail matters, from the precision of the engine components to the elegance of the interior upholstery. As with every restoration project, StreetWorks was committed to preserving the car’s original charm while restoring its performance and appearance.

The Iso Grifo’s bodywork was meticulously restored to its former glory, ensuring that every curve and line reflected the car’s timeless beauty. The mechanics underwent a thorough rejuvenation to deliver a driving experience that matched the car’s visual allure. The interior was crafted with the same care, combining modern comfort with classic aesthetics.
A Star at Pebble Beach 2004

The culmination of our efforts was recognized when the restored Iso Grifo placed in its class at the prestigious Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance car show in 2004. Pebble Beach is a revered stage where automotive legends come to life, and our Iso Grifo stood proudly among them. This achievement was especially meaningful for us. It was not just a testament to the car’s inherent elegance, but a validation of our dedication to craftsmanship as a new restoration shop.

The recognition at Pebble Beach opened doors to new opportunities and further established our reputation as a go-to destination for classic Italian car restoration. It was a moment of pride for our team, knowing that our work had contributed to preserving a piece of automotive history.
A Full Circle Journey

A decade ago, the Iso Grifo was sold to a museum, where it was admired by countless visitors. However, its story was far from over. The original owner, driven by nostalgia and an unbreakable bond with the car, decided to bring it back into his life. The Iso Grifo returned to our shop for another restoration, rekindling the passion that had first driven its transformation. The opportunity to restore the car again is an honor and a profound responsibility.
Lessons Learned and Future Endeavors

Reflecting on the Iso Grifo restoration, several valuable lessons emerge. Patience, attention to detail, and a commitment to excellence are essential for a successful classic vehicle restoration. The collaboration between our team, brand experts, and the customer creates a synergy that elevates the restoration process to new heights.

Looking ahead, StreetWorks is poised to take on new challenges and expand our expertise. The success of the Iso Grifo restoration has inspired a dedication to preserving other classic Italian cars, ensuring that their legacy continues to shine.
A Legacy Continues

The story of the 1967 Iso Grifo GL350 invites you to join the journey of restoration and preservation. Whether you’re embarking on your own restoration project or simply admiring the beauty of classic cars, the Iso Grifo’s tale serves as a source of inspiration. From its humble beginnings with a local Wisconsin resident to its recognition at Pebble Beach and its return to our shop, the Iso Grifo’s journey is a celebration of craftsmanship, artistry, and a committed collector.

This tale demonstrates that, at StreetWorks, we value your car as much as you do. Our decades of restoring classic cars have made us masters of American car brands like Chevrolet and Pontiac and luxury Italian car brands like Ferrari, Maserati, and Lamborghini. We can do it all because we take the time to consult with experts and make sure every detail is done to perfection. In fact, over the years, we have become an industry authority that others come to for guidance.
If you want your classic car to grace the stage of Pebble Beach or even just be displayed with pride in your own personal collection, contact us today. You might be our next success story!
